description:
Summary:

The base class `codegen_subgraph_prefix` and `codegen_while_loop` pass tensor inputs directly to `aoti_torch_assign_tensors_out()`, which expects `AtenTensorHandle`. On the arrayref path, these inputs are `ArrayRefTensor<T>`, causing C++ compilation errors. This adds arrayref-specific overrides that wrap inputs with `borrow_arrayref_tensor_as_tensor()` before the assign call.

This fixes 7 while_loop tests that were previously marked as expected failures for `minimal_arrayref_interface`.

Test Plan:
```
buck test fbcode//mode/opt fbcode//caffe2/test/inductor:aot_inductor_arrayref_cpu_local -- \
  test_while_loop_with_parameters_cpu_with_stack_allocation_and_minimal_arrayref_interface \
  test_while_loop_with_unbacked_symint_closure_dynamic_True_cpu_with_stack_allocation_and_minimal_arrayref_interface \
  test_while_loop_with_sym_expr_cond_dynamic_True_cpu_with_stack_allocation_and_minimal_arrayref_interface \
  test_while_loop_with_conv_dynamic_True_cpu_with_stack_allocation_and_minimal_arrayref_interface
```
All 7 tests pass (previously `COMPILE FAILED` with `no matching function for call to 'aoti_torch_assign_tensors_out'`).
